text:
Petaluma High School standout Samuel Brown’s Harrisburg Senators fall 3-2 to Richmond Flying Squirrels on June 30
By
J. M. NixTuesday, June 30, at 6:30 p.m., the Harrisburg Senators — whose roster includes former Petaluma High School standout Samuel Brown — fell 3-2 to the Richmond Flying Squirrels in a MiLB game.
The game was played at FNB Field. It was the seventh meeting between the teams this season, with the Senators trailing 2-5 in the season series against the Flying Squirrels.
Brown went hitless in four at-bats.
The Senators' next game is scheduled for Wednesday, July 1, at FNB Field against the Harrisburg Senators.
